newsitem.title: ITALY: Two badly hurt in avalanche in Italian Dolomites.
newsitem.headline: Two badly hurt in avalanche in Italian Dolomites.

text.p: An elderly German couple were seriously injured on Sunday in an avalanche in the Dolomites mountains near the Italian-Austrian border, rescuers said.
The man was taken to hospital for treatment but a helicopter was unable to reach his wife. She was being carried down the valley by rescuers.

Officials, who have urged extreme caution in all mountain areas since the recent cold snap, had feared five were missing after two avalanches, but later said the German couple were the only victims. One man died in an avalanche last week.
Across Italy, weather conditions improved but more snow and cold was forecast and the northeast coast was bracing for a fierce "bora", the chill wind that sweeps the Adriatic coast.
